item.title: [Vulnstack1] RCE via MySQL Log File, YxCMS, Pivoting Attack Internal Network
item.author: quactv
item.description: Introduce One idle day wandering around in cyberspace. While reading the blogs of the young and talented Chinese wizards. I happened to come across a series of real-combat red team labs. Seeing that the lab’s scope was quite broad, attacking from the external network into the DMZ then into the internal network, domain, pivoting, going around in circles, … just like the network model of a company or enterprise. So I decided I had to conquer the whole lab series.

item.title: Tunneling, Pivoting to Attack Internal Network
item.author: quactv
item.description: Intro There are plenty of articles and blogs on the Internet talking about attacking and penetrating internal networks, but most of them focus on using the tools, while the principles and scenarios are rarely mentioned or explained much. In this post I’ll discuss the principles of attacking internal networks in various ways, flexibly designing an internal-network attack diagram to match the different internal-network scenarios. This is also one of my favorite topics in cybersecurity and red team operations in general.
